class.name: NNBTSendEvent
class.brief_description: Sends a state tree event from a behaviour tree.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] after dispatching [member event_name] to the target chart, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] when [member event_name] is empty or no target resolves. The target is [member target] when it is set, resolved relative to this leaf; otherwise the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor is used, which is the common case for a behaviour tree hosted below a state. The target is resolved again on every tick, so reparenting the leaf or freeing the target never leaves a stale reference behind. Events are dispatched by the chart: while a transition is in flight the event is queued and processed afterwards. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script.

members.member: The event name to send. An empty name returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] without sending anything.
The chart to send the event to, as a path relative to this leaf. When empty, the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor is used.
